evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first

observations.why: Universal mandate framing — 'every new hire completes' — enacts authority-ranking by prescribing a uniform requirement imposed on all newcomers, the speaker performing institutional authority over the onboarding process.

observations.why: Stating that the checklist 'replaced' a prior system reports a governance decision — one authority superseding another — but the relational signal is thin and the segment is primarily propositional; region-only with reported flag.
